senses.sense_definition: A linear approximation used to analyze or represent a non-linear system.

examples.text: The engineers used a local <w>linearization</w> to evaluate the stability of the flight control model.
This formula represents a simplified <w>linearization</w> of the complex differential equation.

senses.sense_definition: The process of modifying a system so that its output is directly proportional or linearly dependent on its input.

examples.text: Accurate sensor measurement often requires the <w>linearization</w> of the incoming voltage signals.
Hardware modifications achieved effective <w>linearization</w> across all tested operating frequencies.

senses.sense_definition: The enzymatic or physical conversion of a circular or looped DNA molecule into a linear strand.

examples.text: Complete enzymatic digestion ensured the successful <w>linearization</w> of the circular plasmid.
Before conducting gel electrophoresis, the researchers confirmed the full <w>linearization</w> of each sample.
